faq: Will my users lose data or have to sign in again?
No. The redesign changes the interface, not your data or accounts. Users update from the App Store and carry on. We test an update from your current version before handover.
Do you need my existing code?
Yes, we rebuild the screens inside your project, so we need repository access. If you do not have the source code, tell us before ordering, because that case needs a different plan.
Can you redesign just one screen?
Yes. The Basic package is built for a few key screens, such as home, onboarding or checkout. Many owners start there and add more screens later.
Do I get the design files?
Premium includes design files and a short style guide. Smaller packages include mockups of the new screens, and the final result lives in your code.
